note: Enhanced 7-day sweep across LinkedIn (Google/Bing-indexed only, no bot scraping per policy), Indeed, ZipRecruiter, CareerBuilder, Mediabistro, and fractional/interim comms networks. As on recent runs, general web search surfaced mostly aggregators, directories, and marketplace pages rather than fresh, dated, named end-client postings. The strongest concrete new entities this run are one live named end-client role (Nexscient, pre-IPO IR/financial PR) plus two registerable freelance/fractional benches (Mission North, GigX) and one contract-IR staffing channel (Robert Half). Deduped against all prior pr-freelance reports (GrowTal, Select Advisors Institute, Scion Staffing, Capstone Hill, Mediabistro, Fractional Jobs, Hanson Search, Wilson PR, Chameleon Collective, Forthright Advising, MassMutual, Four Pines Fund, JIH PR, The PR Net, OpenText, Pinterest, Hello Human, The Work Crowd, ICA Fund, VOW for Girls excluded).
